A '''''Venator''-class Star Destroyer''' was used by the [[Galactic Empire]] during the early stage of its [[Imperial Era|reign]]. It was present during the [[Project Stardust|construction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[orbit]] of [[Geonosis]]. Newly constructed by [[Santhe Shipyards|Corellian Shipyards]],<ref name="Catalyst" /> the [[Star Destroyer]] lacked the [[Color|red]] markings present on others of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|its kind]] seen during the preceding [[Clone Wars]], instead adopting a grey aesthetic. The Venator ferried [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], his [[Sith apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], and [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] to the Death Star<ref name="Episode III" /> for an inspection<ref name="Insider 226">{{InsiderCite|226|A Certain Point of View}}</ref> of the under construction [[battle station]].<ref name="Episode III" /> The destroyer was assigned to defend the incomplete battle station.<ref name="Force Collection">{{ForceCollection|Barrow Oicunn|star=3}}</ref>

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer first appeared in the [[2005]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III" /> The vessel is mistakenly identified as an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] by ''[[Catalyst: A Rogue One Novel]]''.<ref name="Catalyst" />
